worldcombat.skill.sleeptalk.summary: Usable only while asleep; it randomly performs one of the moves the user has learned.
worldcombat.skill.sleeptalk.use.1: Borrow one known move at random
After mumbling for %1$s it randomly borrows and performs one of its known moves that Sleep Talk can call; charging and other uncallable moves are skipped, and it does not fire when no move is usable.
Sleep Talk reaches %1$s and the borrowed move cannot reach farther; an enemy-targeted move locks onto the nearest foe, while self and ally moves land on the user. Returning to the dream costs %2$s.
